ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 15

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 9
   C. 17
   D. 8

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 30
   C. 60
   D. 38

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 41

15. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

17. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

18. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

20. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 5

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 24

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

23. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 40

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
